notes.title: Dumb Bots Update
notes.notes:
Hi all just a quick update here.

The work is still ongoing to get fully working Bots into the game for those solo players, I have been working away to try and get a dumbed down version in and working so here it is.

Currently bots will fill the match with the remaining of the 10 slots, they are VERY VERY DUMB!
Do not expect a lot from them, they will drive around stealing weapons, and chasing you from time to time but they CAN NOT SHOOT yet.

YOU CAN SHOOT THEM though, this just gives players a way of levelling up their player without being in an online match and hopefully encourage more playtime for future testing.

Please provide me with what you think of the AI so far and let me know suggestions.

Thanks
Rob.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Bots spawn in remaining places
[*] Bots try to steal weapons
[*] Bots try to ram players
[*] Bots can take damage
[*] Bots get destroyed in water just like players
[/list]

notes.title: Ai Testing & New Car Released!
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome[/h3]
It's been a few busy weeks with Uni and family but I have managed to create a Ai movement system that also reverses itself out of trouble if it gets stuck so have decided to release it for some testing and get feedback on how the movement of the Ai feels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/5caf3e2dd7e8f0cbba46ee9212531608ce3cafde.png[/img]

Of course they also have random appearances to make it more interesting too. (Press I key in playground to spawn AI)

[h3]New Car![/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/71520cb0132209cfd9358eb9a765e5ec09a87308.jpg[/img]

That's right, Dan Rover is now available to play, and you only have to reach level 3 to unlock it :D

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
Next up is working on getting the Ai to pickup weapons, aim and shoot at players along with making players able to shoot at the Ai, currently they have collision with the projectiles but no damage is done.

notes.title: Ai Battles Coming & New Car
notes.notes:
[h3]News Update[/h3]
Hello all new players to Autotag, Steam Fest is getting good attention and I hope everyone is enjoying trying my game.
That being said as a solo developer progress is so but I am well on my way to getting working AI cars in the game so people can play solo as well as multiplayer as I understand it can be hard to get friends involved and as its only a small game, finding a match isn't an option.
Before that though there is something I'd like to preview.

[h3]New Car[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/71520cb0132209cfd9358eb9a765e5ec09a87308.jpg[/img]
Meet Dan Rover, the next update will add this new car to the game that can be unlocked at level 5.

[h3]AI Cars is hard![/h3]
So given the game is purely physics based, creating AI bots to battle with is becoming a huge headache once again as there is not a lot of information out there but I have come up with my own intelligence system that should allow for simple but fun AI bots to join in matches.
If you want to keep up to date with latest developments either join the discord or follow me on X as everything gets posted there.

Thanks for your time and I hope you enjoy Autotag!
Rob.

notes.title: Model Overhaul For Release
notes.notes:
Hi all,
Thought it was time for a quick update on what's happening with Autotag.

[h3]What's New?[/h3]
Currently we got approved for release by stream so hopefully soon the game will come into early access for all to find and play for free.
Yes the game will be completely free, as a solo dev it's been had enough just getting playtesters nevermind releasing a multiplayer game with zero marketing where people can't find matches. 
I am only interested in people finding and playing my game so as long as people play I will be happy.

I have temporary removed controller support due to some menu issues I have found and to help it get through the Steam approval.

For release I am overhauling all the car models, weapons and maps to make the game a little more interesting before release, I have learned a lot in terms of modeling and using blender so It is worth making changes to the game to make it a lot nicer looking and also get rid of any assets currently used.

[h3]Playtest Status[/h3] 
The playtest is still live and ready to access if people are looking to provide me with as much feedback as possible before release so get your friends and download the playtest It would really help me out.

Thanks all for reading and here is a little preview of a new car model being added soon!

notes.title: Development Log #4
notes.notes:
[h1]Overview[/h1]
The time has come for another major update log.
This one is a game changer!
A lot of work has been going into Autotag recently and that is to make it ready to release into early access as free to play! That's right, I just want people to play and enjoy this game now so I feel like free to play is the way this game will become more known amongst friend groups to play together.

[h1]What's changed?[/h1]
Here is a run down of what's new.
[b]
[u][h3]Player Levels[/h3][/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/902644266e48f1f4a5cffeaa3a2d699856c51ac4.png[/img]
So players now have a progression system, think WOW but lame! So each kill or tag will increase your level which then increases your ability to unlock new custom colours and cars (more to come).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/d7caa760f7a58d7bba056b4457d549115d2c7bef.png[/img]

[b][u][h3]Chat box[/h3][/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/c168365c94711e510b011bbff00110ffb2d21ef8.png[/img]
Yep that's right, there is now a chat box you can use to talk to people in your game. But say a bad word and the server will out you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/11c4dffaa5eadbaea70f707f192b840a6b5ad9ac.png[/img]

[b][u][h3]Multiple map selection[/h3][/u][/b]
I've scrapped the gamemode selection on the create game menu and changed it to a map selection where you will be able to choose from a few different maps or put it to random and get a new map each game (WIP).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/5f967f751881b1815ab127982e1ae2d4e2ae242e.png[/img]

[b][u][h3]Help I'm a Turtle![/h3][/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/11c4dffaa5eadbaea70f707f192b840a6b5ad9ac.png[/img]
So in testing we sometimes had an accident that would lead to the car getting stuck, well now we have a way to fix that because of the new chat box.
If you type /stuck in the chat box the server will destroy you and you will respawn just as if you had been killed.

[h1]That's all[/h1]
Well I think that wraps it up, thank you all for your time and please wishlist the game if you haven't to be notified of the release date!

notes.title: Should I Make Autotag F2P?
notes.notes:
Hi all,

It's proving difficult to find willing play testers to play Autotag enough to get feedback and without feedback it's hard to continue development on a multiplayer game.

Should I bight the bullet so to speak and release the game as free to play and create a community around it?

Let me know what you thing.

Rob.

notes.title: Development Log #1
notes.notes:
[u][i][h1]Welcome[/h1][/i][/u]
Well hello all and thank you so much for all the Wishlist's so far it's great to see an interest in my game.
Now I figured as the game gets further in development it's worth updating everyone here on the current progress and plans.
So without rambling on too much here is the first Dev Log for Autotag.

[i][u][h2]Progress[/h2][/u][/i]
So the game has been coming along really well with it being well on track for it's first multiplayer playtesting session (If you would like to get involved then please join the discord on the store page).

[h3]Scope View[/h3]
The first thing that I wanted to get in the game was a big change in how the camera, aiming and shooting is played out. So after getting multiple requests from my testers I raised the camera location above the car, fixed issues where aiming would be locked below the camera view and I also added the ability to switch to a scope style view (no zoom but focus from the weapons barrel).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/fe8b849e6e2284de8f886b03cb5223e9187c23df.gif[/img]
[i]Scope view in use[/i]

[h3]Random Time Play[/h3]
So along with the new scope view I have played and tested on the map so much that I feel like over time the same map will get boring quick and until I add multiple maps to the game it's worth making a feature that will allow each game to have it's own challenge and variety.

This is where random time of day comes in when the match begins.
What does this mean? 
Well I have added lighting to the destructible lampposts and given player cars headlights in order to allow there to be night matches.
Each game start will randomly choose a time of day, if it's night then all the lights will be on and if its day time then all the lights will be turned off and you can enjoy the sunshine around your battle.

This is a small feature that I'd like to get feedback on where possible so let me know what you all think below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860884/eae6d21933a18fb17085b4860d1551ad62bd888c.gif[/img]  
[i]Speeding through time to show light mechanic in play[/i]

[i][u][h2]Timescale Update[/h2][/u][/i]
Each devlog will include a timescale update to keep you all up to date on how the game development is going.
Currently I am hoping to get more people involved to join the playtest planned for the next weekend everyone is free. 
This will be the first and biggest test yet so don't miss out.

[i][u][h2]Final Thoughts[/h2][/u][/i]
Thank you all for taking the time to get this far and I hope to hear a lot of feedback on what you think of this weeks progress and any suggestions you may have.

Thank you
Rob.
